nodes.name: Every Monday 09:00
nodes.notes: Runs in the n8n SERVER's timezone -- check the instance timezone and shift the cron hour if you want this to land at 09:00 for the product owner (overseas, UTC+8).

parameters.query:
-- Weekly counts by event type. VERIFY before first activation that the
-- timestamp column on app_bot_events is really named created_at
-- (\d app_bot_events) -- the insert statements in the main workflow rely
-- on a DB-side default for it, so the name was never spelled out there.
SELECT event_key, COUNT(*) AS n
FROM app_bot_events
WHERE event_category = 'the AI service'
  AND created_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days'
GROUP BY event_key
ORDER BY n DESC;

-- The questions the AI service couldn't answer this week, most frequent first.
-- event_name holds the first 255 chars of the customer's question.
SELECT event_name AS question, COUNT(*) AS n
FROM app_bot_events
WHERE event_category = 'the AI service'
  AND event_key = 'unanswered'
  AND created_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days'
GROUP BY event_name
ORDER BY n DESC, question
LIMIT 30;
